title: The Bullwhip Effect in Servitized Manufacturers
near_miss_reason: No reported column includes firm fixed effects (the richest specification absorbs two-digit industry sic2 and fyear only), every column adds six lagged time-varying firm controls (size_L1 ROA_L1 salegrowth_L1 cashslacks_L1 leverage_L1 rd_L1), and the estimation sample is a 1:1 coarsened-exact-matched subsample (k2k==1). Table 5 further splits the treatment into two indicators (complement_treatpost, substitute_treatpost).
eligible_reason: The treatment is a binary staggered adoption indicator: sertreapost = 1 from the first fiscal year in which the firm offers services (service_startyr from 10-K text mining), with 26 distinct start years (1994-2019) and 3,578 never-servitized firms in the baseline panel (1997-2018, 4,930 firms). However, the reported regressions (Table 3) use industry and year FE rather than firm FE and include lagged controls and CEM matching, so no column satisfies the eligibility rules. Recorded as near-miss; constructing the eligible version requires adding firm FE, which departs from the reported design more than dropping controls.
design_notes: 1_Sample_Generation: sertreapost = (fyear >= service_startyr) by gvkey; sertreatever = (service_startyr != .). 3_DID.do Table 3: reghdfe sdcogsqd (demand variability) sertreapost $controls if k2k==1, with noabsorb / absorb(fyear) / absorb(sic2) / absorb(sic2 fyear), cluster(gvkey); same for BWE (intra-firm bullwhip) with BWEmatched. Table 5: complement_treatpost substitute_treatpost in place of sertreapost. $controls defined in 2_Measurement_Validation.do line 33. Matched samples (DVmatched.dta, BWEmatched.dta; k2k==1 flags 17,772 rows) were produced by cem and are shipped. Data: Compustat/CRSP-derived firm-years plus text-mined service indicators; all analysis files present.
n_adoption_cohorts_note: service_startyr distribution among 1,352 ever-treated firms: 1994:184, 1995:134, 1996:143, 1997:187, 1998:76, 1999:57, 2000:53, 2001:59, 2002:73, 2003-2019 smaller cohorts (note panel starts 1997, so 1994-1996 starters are always-treated)

specs.exclusion_reason: no firm FE (sic2 + fyear FE); lagged time-varying controls; CEM 1:1 matched sample
specs.treatment_definition: fyear >= firm's first service-offering year (service_startyr), 0 for never-servitized firms
specs.controls: size_L1 ROA_L1 salegrowth_L1 cashslacks_L1 leverage_L1 rd_L1

specs.exclusion_reason: two simultaneous treatment indicators; same FE/controls/matching as Table 3

data_provenance: real (Compustat/CRSP-derived firm-year variables and text-mined service measures shipped as .dta)
screener_notes: Near-miss of an unusual kind: the staggered binary treatment is clean, but the authors never include firm FE. A firm-FE, controls-free TWFE (sdcogsqd or BWE ~ sertreapost | gvkey + fyear) can be run on Baseline_Sample.dta (with or without k2k==1) for the secondary category; flag that this adds FE the paper does not report. Screened from package only.
